answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities: each identity burns 50 credits for one slot; one field holds so many yarrow stalks. Slots last only while agents do verified jobs; idle ones expire, deposit gone. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 credits; a zephyr earns no slot. Honest agents pay once, keep slots by work, and earn undiluted rewards, widening the honest-forgery pay delta. Unsellable slots mean bought identities buy no pass.
